related.title: AdamW：解耦權重衰減
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付首步表、連續兩步手算與恢復一致性測試。；.2與.4首步校正正確，checkpoint往返保留step與兩個動量。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver first-step tables, two-step derivations and resume-consistency tests.; Corrected moments match and checkpoint roundtrips preserve step and both moments.
related.difference: 畫梯度路與衰減路兩支，標哪些參數群組排除衰減；本例只含一個普通權重。；1.998與1.996吻合，零梯度/None差異與群組設定有紀錄。
related.differenceEn: Draw gradient and decay paths; identify excluded parameter groups, with one ordinary weight in this example.; Values match and zero/None behavior and group settings are documented.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: mt=β1m前+(1−β1)g，mhat=mt/(1−β1^t)；零初始下首步mhat應等於g。；教學m0=0,β1=.9,t1,g=.2；另從零起始用g=.4。；mhat=.1×.2/(1−.9)=.2；另一案=.4。
在顯式零梯度且先前兩個Adam動量皆為零的示例中θ新=(1−ηλ)θ；若舊動量非零仍有梯度路更新。衰減不先混入動量。；教學θ2,η.01,λ.1；顯式梯度及先前兩個動量皆為0；改λ.2。；θ新=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998；改後1.996。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: mt=beta1 m_prev+(1−beta1)g and mhat=mt/(1−beta1^t); at the first step from zero,mhat equals g.; Teaching m0=0,beta1.9,t1,g.2; a separate zero-initialized run uses g.4.; mhat=.1×.2/(1−.9)=.2; the other run gives.4.

With an explicit zero gradient and both prior Adam moments zero,theta_new=(1−eta lambda)theta; nonzero prior moments still produce an adaptive update. Decay does not first enter the moments.; Teaching theta2,learning rate.01,decay.1 then.2,with an explicit zero gradient and both prior moments zero.; theta_new=(1−.01×.1)×2=1.998; changed result1.996.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: NVIDIA Tensor Core：矩陣片段與工作量契約
related.titleEn: NVIDIA Tensor Cores: matrix fragments and workload contracts
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付首步表、連續兩步手算與恢復一致性測試。；.2與.4首步校正正確，checkpoint往返保留step與兩個動量。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver first-step tables, two-step derivations and resume-consistency tests.; Corrected moments match and checkpoint roundtrips preserve step and both moments.
related.difference: 把矩陣形狀、MAC、FLOP 與資料型別分開標記，能以純量迴圈重建每個輸出。
related.differenceEn: Label shapes, MACs, FLOPs and data types separately and reconstruct each output with scalar loops.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: mt=β1m前+(1−β1)g，mhat=mt/(1−β1^t)；零初始下首步mhat應等於g。；教學m0=0,β1=.9,t1,g=.2；另從零起始用g=.4。；mhat=.1×.2/(1−.9)=.2；另一案=.4。
C=AB，A 為 M×K、B 為 K×N；約 2MNK FLOP 採每次乘及加各算一次的慣例。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 M=N=16，K=32；兩輸入為 16 bit，累加器為 32 bit。 MAC=16×16×32=8192；F=2×8192=16384 FLOP。這是工作量，未包含搬移或啟動時間。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: mt=beta1 m_prev+(1−beta1)g and mhat=mt/(1−beta1^t); at the first step from zero,mhat equals g.; Teaching m0=0,beta1.9,t1,g.2; a separate zero-initialized run uses g.4.; mhat=.1×.2/(1−.9)=.2; the other run gives.4.

For C=AB with M×K and K×N inputs, approximately 2MNK FLOPs counts one multiply and one add per MAC. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. M=N=16, K=32; inputs use 16 bits and accumulators 32 bits. MACs=16×16×32=8192; F=2×8192=16384 FLOPs, excluding transfers and launch time.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
